note: Gated RV park established 1986 at I-95 Exit 49 next to McDonald's, on a bluff beside Cathead Creek near Darien; on-site resident managers. Rates are given by phone only; many guests winter here. --Claude
summary: Operator site (http only) confirms 60 paved pull-throughs + 10 back-ins, full hookups with cable (no amperage - note 50 A cleared), laundry/bath house, phone-only reservations, cash/check only. Rates 'CALL FOR DAILY, WEEKLY AND MONTHLY RATES' - fees stay unset; RV Life campers in 2026 paid $55 (motorhome), which can't price the entry because the operator has a web page. Note's RoverPass/Hipcamp and ~$35 dropped. Pin ~100 m from directory points, fine.
flags: US$50 GATE (probably over): the operator posts no rate ('CALL FOR DAILY, WEEKLY AND MONTHLY RATES'). RV Life camper reports for 2026 stays: $55 a night in a motorhome (Jul, Sep, Oct 2026, four reports) and $50 in a travel trailer (Jul 2026). Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km (Savannah 84 km); the family has not stayed here. The note's '~$35' was stale and is dropped.

WATERFRONT LEAD (contrary operator claim): stored 'not waterfront'. The operator says the park is 'On a High Bluff Overlooking the Scenic Altamaha River Basin' and 'Situated on a bluff adjacent to Cathead Creek'. On z18 imagery the southernmost pads (~31.39107,-81.44681) sit ~25-30 m from the tidal creek at ~31.39087,-81.44697, across a strip of trees on the bluff, with boats moored at the creek bend just west. The stored evidence says the treeline screens the pads; whether any pad has an open view of the creek needs a ground-level look. No change made.
WEBSITE: http://www.inlandharborrvpark.com/ works; https does not answer (stored URL is http, fine).
PAYMENT: cash or personal check only, no cards (now in booking.note).
LONG-STAY (passes): 'The majority of our guests return year after year, and many winter with us', but nightly stays are sold and campers report nightly stays in 2026.
